{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to std::optional in MiniMiner return types and out-parameter error propagation in AvailableCoins; both resolved"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:2984747958",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "unnecessary diff and interface complexity when checking emptiness is equivalent",
      "quote": "Changing this to be `std::optional` seems a bit unnecessary to me as it's equivalently easy to check for `!empty()`.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2985301923"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2985301923",
      "settled_by_quote": "Makes sense. I'll simplify this by keeping the map return type and detecting failure based on whether entries were produced for all requested outpoints"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3170963339",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "AvailableCoins propagates errors through an out-parameter instead of returning a result type or extending CoinsResult",
      "quote": "I don't think this is the right way to propagate errors out of `AvailableCoins`.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3816840826"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3816840826",
      "settled_by_quote": "Took the second option, `AvailableCoins` now returns `util::Result<CoinsResult>`"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Initial record: achow101 raised two interface objections regarding MiniMiner return types and AvailableCoins error handling. Both were adopted and implemented by the author in subsequent pushes."
}
